panel.introduction: 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko is the two-lobed comet explored by Rosetta. Rotate its measured nucleus to inspect the narrow neck, steep cliffs and recessed terrain.

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

controls.label: OSIRIS observation
controls.description: OSIRIS orange-filter observation, 5 August 2014. Grayscale with approximate illumination correction; residual photographed shadows remain. Gray grid marks missing or rejected imagery. Shadows off shows the corrected image uniformly lit; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch. This is not an albedo map.
